value.rationale: The 2013 initiating metric and its qualitative compactness method yield a mathematically natural finite-to-infinite transition at the circumradius; this theorem quantifies it in the full two-parameter smooth ellipse family. The canonical minor-axis trace has a sharp aspect-ratio-dependent leading constant, and an explicit logarithmic construction bounds the full covering number, giving meaningful structural and asymptotic insight beyond the qualitative literature.
